title: When An Entitled Woman Lacks Basic Home Training
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On January 21st, 2024. Officers were called to an apartment complex regarding three women who were involved in a major dispute. One woman had passed a comment saying that the other woman needed to be a better mother to her daughter and that's when things escalated.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
